name: Postgres MCP Pro
description: MCP server for PostgreSQL schema inspection, safe SQL execution, health checks, and index tuning.

envVars.description: Access mode: restricted for read-only safety, unrestricted for development
SSE MCP port exposed by the server

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{{envRaw.POSTGRES_MCP_PORT}}:{{envRaw.POSTGRES_MCP_PORT}}"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URI: {{env.DATABASE_URI}}
    command: ["--access-mode={{envRaw.POSTGRES_MCP_ACCESS_MODE}}", "--transport=sse"]
